name: Papagayo
hero_description: Private resorts, quiet bays and easy access to Guanacaste adventures.
description: Papagayo combines exclusive resorts, calm Pacific beaches and convenient access to Liberia International Airport. It is an excellent base for travelers who want private service, relaxation and memorable day trips.
why_visit: The Papagayo Peninsula is home to some of Costa Rica's most exclusive resort properties, set along calm Pacific bays with easy access to Liberia International Airport. The area combines private service with the natural beauty of Guanacaste.

For travelers who prioritize private, privacy and comfort alongside nature and adventure, Papagayo offers an unmatched base. Private tours to volcanoes, rainforests and wildlife sanctuaries are accessible without long drives.
highlights: Home to Four Seasons, Andaz, Nekajui and other private resorts
Calm, protected Pacific bays ideal for swimming and water sports
30 to 45 minutes from Liberia International Airport
Private and exclusive atmosphere with high-end dining
Easy access to Guanacaste's top tours and experiences
Ideal for honeymoons, anniversaries and private travel
considerations: Very resort-focused, limited local dining options outside hotel properties
Higher price range than other Guanacaste destinations
Less walkable than beach towns like Playa Coco or Tamarindo

faq.q: Which resorts are located in Papagayo?
faq.a: The peninsula is home to Four Seasons Resort Costa Rica, Andaz Costa Rica, Nekajui a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Secrets Papagayo, Planet Hollywood, El Mangroove and other private properties.

faq.q: How far is Papagayo from Liberia Airport?
faq.a: Most Papagayo resorts are 30 to 45 minutes from Liberia International Airport by private transfer.
Yes. The calm bays, private resort amenities and family-friendly tour options make Papagayo an excellent choice for families seeking a premium Costa Rica experience.

faq.q: Can I take day tours from Papagayo?
faq.a: Absolutely. Private tours to Rincon de la Vieja, hanging bridges, wildlife sanctuaries and other Guanacaste attractions depart easily from the Papagayo area.

adventure.reason: Private tours to volcanoes, rainforests and wildlife sanctuaries are accessible without long drives.

families.reason: Listed as good for families and calm bays ideal for swimming, though it's resort-focused and pricey.

nightlife.reason: Coco's Tiki Bar and Prieta/Olas beach clubs appear in the list, but options are limited outside resorts.

restaurants.reason: Multiple highly-rated venues like Niri Beach Club (5/5) and Taru Restaurante (4.9/5), though dining is largely resort-based.

beach.reason: Calm, protected Pacific bays ideal for swimming and water sports.

wildlife.reason: Easy access to wildlife sanctuaries and rainforests via private tours.

relaxation.reason: Emphasizes private service, comfort and relaxation with exclusive resorts on calm bays.

difficulty.reason: Only 30 to 45 minutes from Liberia International Airport with convenient access.

private.reason: Home to Four Seasons, Andaz, Nekajui and other private resorts with high-end dining.
